name: Ancient Trinket
description:
You have a small, ancient relic retrieved from the harbor of Agralao.

When you gain this ability, choose one effect:

  • Once per Quest when you roll Craft, +2d.

  • Once per Quest, you may spent a half action to activate the trinket, which grants you darkvision for one hour.

  • Roll 2d20. The result is the trinket's cost, in treasure.

Your relic is permanently imbued with this effect.

Describe how you activate the relic.
